title: Constructed augmentation to the strict quotient cone
statement: For a prime l, finite E/Q_l, scheme Y and complex P, define P→H(D(P)) by the existing mappingCocone.lift, using the product tuple of actual quotient units as its first coordinate and the zero cochain as its shifted coordinate.

proof.text: Use the proved lift condition for the actual tuple. The existing mapping-cocone construction then supplies a chain map with these two specified coordinates; no data is chosen from existence.

proof_origin.place: Clauses (2)–(3), explicit strict quotient augmentation and multiplication cancellation.
